description: This file contains test functions for parsing, splitting, escaping, and matching field selectors in Kubernetes API machinery. It includes unit tests for functions like splitTerms, splitTerm, EscapeValue, UnescapeValue, ParseSelector, and matching logic, specifically for the selector_test.go in the 'fields' package.

methods.name: TestSplitTerms
methods.description: Unit test for splitTerms function, verifying correct splitting of selector strings into terms.

methods.name: TestSplitTerm
methods.description: Unit test for splitTerm function, verifying correct parsing of individual terms into lhs, operator, rhs.

methods.name: TestEscapeValue
methods.description: Unit test for EscapeValue and UnescapeValue functions, verifying proper escaping and unescaping of special characters.

methods.name: TestSelectorParse
methods.description: Unit test for ParseSelector function, verifying correct parsing of selector strings into selector objects.

methods.name: TestDeterministicParse
methods.description: Unit test to ensure parsing of equivalent selector strings results in identical selector objects.

methods.name: expectMatch
methods.description: Helper function to assert that a selector matches a given set.

methods.name: expectNoMatch
methods.description: Helper function to assert that a selector does not match a given set.

methods.name: TestEverything
methods.description: Unit test for the Everything() selector, verifying it matches any set and is empty.

methods.name: TestSelectorMatches
methods.description: Comprehensive tests for selector matching logic with various selector strings and sets.

methods.name: TestOneTermEqualSelector
methods.description: Test for OneTermEqualSelector function, verifying matching behavior for single-term equality selectors.

methods.name: expectMatchDirect
methods.description: Helper to assert that a selector from a set matches a given set.

methods.name: expectNoMatchDirect
methods.description: Helper to assert that a selector from a set does not match a given set.

methods.name: TestSetMatches
methods.description: Tests for matching sets against selectors, including edge cases and invalid patterns.

methods.name: TestNilMapIsValid
methods.description: Test that a nil set produces an 'Everything' selector that is empty.

methods.name: TestSetIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests for the Empty() method on various set and term objects.

methods.name: TestRequiresExactMatch
methods.description: Tests for the RequiresExactMatch method on selectors, verifying correct retrieval of exact match values.

methods.name: TestTransform
methods.description: Tests for ParseAndTransformSelector, verifying transformation of selectors with custom functions.
